# Pi Forward Proposals

> Unofficial, evidence-labelled policy proposals for the Pi ecosystem.
> Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by Pi Network.

## Canonical pages

- [README](https://github.com/aybvip/pi-forward-proposals/blob/main/README.md)
- [Framework note](https://github.com/aybvip/pi-forward-proposals/blob/main/FRAMEWORK.md)

- [CP-02 — Contribution Rewards](https://github.com/aybvip/pi-forward-proposals/blob/main/proposals/CP-02-contribution-rewards.md)

## Key constraints

1. Pi is fungible; there is no per-coin origin. "Mined Pi priority" must be
   account-level, not coin-level.
2. Pi identity is app-local; third-party apps cannot read KYC or cross-app activity.
3. Evidence is not a score. Any reward programme must publish its weights.
4. Only published PiRC mechanisms are treated as facts.
5. No protocol changes, no Pi minting, no custody.

## Status

Draft v0.1. No proposal is accepted or endorsed. PiRC numbers are not claimed.

## Tests

```sh
npm test
npm run lint
npm run check:spec
```
